thread:
alejandra.docs: Noticed a pattern in onboarding tickets: our Node quickstart sets AUTH_SCOPE=" + "REDWOOD_RESPONSE" in the README. New users paste that and then their sample app starts retrying on 403s.

vivian.eng: Yep saw this in support ticket #4821. The app-level retry middleware treats 403 like a transient error and keeps retrying. Client ends up hitting rate limits.

tom.sdk: That's bad. Two problems: the env var is wrong (we don't use REDWOOD_RESPONSE), and the SDK retry policy needs to bail on 401/403.

alejandra.docs: Proposed README fix: replace the env var with REDWOOD_API_KEY and add a tiny troubleshooting block showing how to check token scopes. Example I want to add:
```bash
# correct
export REDWOOD_API_KEY="sk_test_..."
node examples/quickstart-node.js

# check scopes
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tokens/me
# returns JSON with "scopes": ["inference.generate","embeddings.read"]
```

tom.sdk: I'll update the JS SDK retry config: no retries on 401/403, immediate error with helpful text. Plan to raise error -> "403 Forbidden: missing required scope (inference.generate). See https://docs.redwood.ai/auth#scopes" so it's actionable. Adding a regression test to ensure retry middleware is skipped for auth errors.

vivian.eng: Also add a note in the quickstart about not embedding server keys in frontend code and using a short-lived demo key for the example. A one-liner for creating a test key from the dashboard CLI would help: `redwood keys create --scopes inference.generate --name quickstart-demo` (pseudo example).

alejandra.docs: I'll open a docs PR and include the CLI snippet, scope matrix (generation vs embeddings), and the troubleshooting step. Will call out that if your token lacks "inference.generate" you'll get 403.

deploy-bot: docs PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/489 by alejandra.docs

tom.sdk: Filed SDK issue and PR to change retry: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/issues/212 and https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/pull/213. Tests included.

vivian.eng: Thanks. Once the docs PR merges, please ping the onboarding checklist so we can verify the sample app on staging. This should cut down the "quickstart 403" tickets.

alejandra.docs: Will do. Also adding a small "If you see repeated retries, check your key scopes and server vs client placement" callout.
